programs.title: Cross-market lead-lag research program
programs.objective: Determine whether pre-match cross-market dynamics contain stable, independent and economically useful information beyond contemporaneous bookmaker market state.
programs.current_frontier: Program closed after failed independent replication, completed seven-season regime audit, completed 2024/25 source/market anomaly audit, and duplicate detection on Issue #513. No genuinely independent zero-cost preregisterable follow-up remains without reformulating the rejected statistic or requiring new paid intraday data.
stop_rules: Do not weaken or reinterpret the frozen V1/V2 validation gates.
Do not create another cosmetic transform of a rejected alignment statistic unless it is independently preregistered and mechanistically distinct.
Do not use match outcomes that were reserved for an untouched evaluation before the gate is frozen.
Do not request paid timestamped/intraday data without fresh explicit user approval.
Mark PROGRAM_DONE when no genuinely independent zero-cost preregisterable follow-up remains.
programs.program_done_reason: The zero-cost evidence stack is exhausted: V1/V2 remain unsupported/NO_BET; temporal regime stability was already audited; the 2024/25 source/market explanation was not supported; the proposed next temporal-stability child #513 duplicated existing work. Remaining options are cosmetic transforms of the rejected signal or fresh timestamped intraday data, which requires explicit user approval.

programs.title: Kickoff and calendar context research program
programs.objective: Determine whether kickoff time, weekday, calendar slot or related pre-kickoff context contains stable incremental information beyond market baselines.
programs.current_frontier: The pooled kickoff/calendar OOS test is negative, the preregistered league-heterogeneity follow-up (#514) found no stable validation+OOT pairwise heterogeneity, and the independent outcome-free opening-to-closing market-movement mechanism (#523) also failed its OOT bootstrap gate. The pooled null remains binding and the zero-cost mechanistic frontier is exhausted.
stop_rules: Do not search arbitrary time cutoffs, weekdays or leagues after seeing results.
Any heterogeneity test must freeze the comparison rule before evaluating league-specific outcomes.
Do not treat a subgroup win as rescuing the rejected pooled hypothesis.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval.
Mark PROGRAM_DONE when remaining follow-ups would be threshold mining or restatements of the rejected pooled test.
programs.program_done_reason: Issue #523 tested the last genuinely independent zero-cost mechanism allowed by the program: Bet365 O/U 2.5 opening-to-closing repricing with a frozen temporal OOS design. Calendar features reduced MSE only microscopically in validation and OOT, while the OOT paired-bootstrap 95% CI crossed zero (-8.102e-06 to +3.630e-06). Together with the negative pooled outcome test (#428) and negative preregistered league heterogeneity (#514), remaining zero-cost follow-ups would be threshold/weekday/league mining, cosmetic temporal restatements, or require new paid/prospective data. The stop rule therefore requires PROGRAM_DONE.

programs.title: Cross-market corner direction research program
programs.objective: Determine whether the frozen cross-market match-shape gap contains stable, transferable information about pre-match corner-market direction or ranking beyond trivial UP skew.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #522 found an encouraging continuous same-sample rank association after frozen residualization, but binary direction remained below the always-UP baseline. The genuinely independent zero-cost cross-league transport in Issue #528 passed its outcome-free coverage gate (74/74 Bundesliga and Ligue 1 matches) but did not transfer after controlling for the mechanical opening component: residual Spearman was 0.0503, deterministic permutation p=0.4125, the two leave-one-league residual signs opposed each other, and binary accuracy 0.6818 remained below the 0.7273 always-UP baseline. The program therefore ends NO_BET with cross-league transfer unsupported.
stop_rules: Do not retune match_shape_gap, its sign, Ridge alpha, FAIR_CENTRE definition or thresholds on the already-opened 194 corner movements.
Do not exclude weak cohorts or leagues post-hoc and do not use closing/in-play information as pre-match features.
Do not collect new prospective matches inside Issue #522.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval.
Mark PROGRAM_DONE when independent zero-cost evidence is exhausted or fails to support future confirmation.
programs.program_done_reason: The program's final permitted independent zero-cost test failed. Issue #528 transported the frozen match-shape signal without retuning to Bundesliga and Ligue 1 and found that the apparent raw correlation was dominated by the mechanical opening-line component; residual association was negligible and non-significant, league-held-out signs were inconsistent, and classification did not beat trivial UP skew. Existing work already covers same-sample falsification (#522), cross-league FAIR_CENTRE holdout (#385), historical CORNERS10/xG/shots/deep/rest/travel/volatility families, and the six-signal screen. Further zero-cost children would retune the already-opened movements, threshold-mine, or restate the same signal; genuinely fresh prospective or paid data is outside current authority. The stop rule therefore requires PROGRAM_DONE.

programs.title: 1. Bookmaker price formation research program
programs.objective: Test whether football odds movement contains separable common-information, bookmaker-specific repricing and margin components, without claiming unobserved bet-flow causality.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #532 completed the frozen Bet365/Pinnacle opening-to-closing decomposition across EPL, La Liga and Serie A with NO_STABLE_BOOKMAKER_SPECIFIC_PRICE_COMPONENT. Bookmaker-specific variance was non-trivial and not explained by overround alone, but common movement did not pass the untouched-OOT stability gate and only one league improved. Issue #553 then attempted the independent Bundesliga/Ligue 1 cross-book transport, but correctly stopped before reading outcomes: none of BW, IW, WH or VC met the frozen >=90% paired opening+closing coverage requirement in both OOS seasons and both leagues, so the terminal result is BLOCKED_BY_SOURCE_GAP. No economic-value or production claim is supported.
stop_rules: Do not infer bettor flow, bookmaker liabilities or intent from observational odds alone.
Do not fabricate/interpolate missing 24h, 6h or 1h snapshots.
Do not select bookmakers, leagues or probability bands after reading OOT outcomes.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval.
Do not promote any resulting feature to production inside this program.
programs.program_done_reason: All permitted zero-cost independent classes are exhausted. Issue #532 completed price-component decomposition and temporal stability; Issue #553 completed source feasibility for cross-bookmaker transport and proved the available source cannot satisfy its preregistered third-book gate. The economic_value_if_statistically_supported class is unavailable because #532 did not establish stable statistical support and #553 could not pass its outcome-free source gate. Repeating Bet365/Pinnacle, lowering the frozen coverage threshold, choosing books or leagues after inspection, or reusing opened outcomes would be duplicate or post-hoc; broader exact opening/closing coverage requires new data, and paid data is prohibited without fresh explicit approval. The program closes research-only with no production or betting authorization.

programs.title: 2. De-vig method OOS research program
programs.objective: Determine whether Multiplicative, Additive, Power or Shin transforms bookmaker 1X2 odds into the most accurate and stable out-of-sample fair probabilities for Football AI.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #533 found NO_STABLE_DEVIG_WINNER on EPL/La Liga/Serie A. The frozen Power candidate then failed independent Bundesliga/Ligue 1 transport in Issue #540: point estimates improved for both books and both leagues, but validation did not improve and the untouched-test fixture-cluster 95% CI crossed zero (-0.00335 to +0.00134). No de-vig method is authorized for promotion.
stop_rules: Do not add post-hoc de-vig variants after OOT results are read.
Do not silently clip mathematically invalid probabilities; report coverage/failure explicitly.
Do not select a winner from OOT and reuse the same OOT as confirmation.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval.
Any winner is research-only and requires a separate untouched promotion study.
programs.program_done_reason: The preregistered method audit, paired temporal OOS comparison, bookmaker stability, calibration diagnostics and independent league transport are complete. Power failed both the original confirmation gate (#533) and the independent transport gate (#540). Additional zero-cost children would add post-hoc transforms, reuse opened OOT outcomes, or reselect a winner from the same evidence, all forbidden by the stop rules. A genuinely untouched future-season promotion study is not justified without a supported winner.

programs.title: 3. Favourite-longshot bias research program
programs.objective: Test whether favourite-longshot calibration and return distortions are stable in Football AI historical data and how they change from opening toward closing.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #534 found NO_STABLE_FAVOURITE_LONGSHOT_BIAS on EPL/La Liga/Serie A. The frozen independent Bundesliga/Ligue 1 transport in Issue #542 also failed: validation and untouched-test pooled slope CIs crossed zero, validation league signs were inconsistent, and the preregistered favourite/longshot region direction failed in validation. No calibration correction or betting rule is supported.
stop_rules: Do not change probability bins after seeing outcomes.
Do not cherry-pick leagues, bookmakers, seasons or outcome types to rescue a pooled null.
Do not fabricate/interpolate missing intraday snapshots.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval.
Do not fit and validate a probability correction on the same untouched OOT sample.
programs.program_done_reason: The program completed the frozen opening/closing temporal audit, bookmaker comparison, calibration/return diagnostics and independent cross-league replication. Neither #534 nor #542 cleared its preregistered stability gates. Further zero-cost children would change bins, cherry-pick leagues/books/seasons, or refit a correction on already-opened OOT outcomes, which the stop rules forbid. The program therefore ends research-only and NO_BET.

programs.title: 4. Bookmaker margin structure research program
programs.objective: Test whether bookmakers systematically differ in total 1X2 margin and in how that margin is allocated across favourites, draws and longshots on the same matches.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #535 established stable matched-fixture Bet365/Pinnacle 1X2 margin-allocation heterogeneity, including a separate draw-pricing report, opening/closing comparison, temporal validation/OOT stability and alternate-consensus sensitivity. Issue #548 then completed the independent same-fixture Asian Handicap transport: the source gate passed and the validation/OOT pooled signs agreed, but the untouched-test AH effect was -0.00227 with a 95% CI of [-0.00531, +0.00097], so NO_STABLE_CROSS_MARKET_MARGIN_STRUCTURE. The supported 1X2 result remains observational and market-specific; no betting edge or production change is supported.
stop_rules: Do not compare bookmakers on non-matched fixture populations and call it a bookmaker effect.
Do not choose bookmakers after reading outcome performance.
Do not make causal claims about demand elasticity or bookmaker intent from observational prices alone.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval.
Any weighting/calibration change is research-only and requires a separate untouched promotion study.
programs.program_done_reason: All permitted zero-cost independent classes are exhausted. Issue #535 already completed source feasibility, matched bookmaker comparison, draw-specific pricing, opening-versus-closing temporal stability and alternate-consensus checks. Issue #548 completed the remaining independent market-type comparison and failed its frozen untouched-test CI gate. Repeating the 1X2 result, subdividing the already-opened outcomes, changing bookmakers after outcome inspection or retuning the AH contract would not be independent; broader exact timestamp/bookmaker coverage would require new data outside the current zero-cost source. The program therefore closes research-only with the supported 1X2 structural result unchanged and no production or betting authorization.

programs.title: Direction 1: result versus process divergence
programs.objective: Determine whether a frozen mismatch between recent points and shots-on-target process adds stable 1X2 probability information beyond a fitted bookmaker market baseline.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #562 completed the frozen Bundesliga/Ligue 1 temporal-OOS test. Validation showed tiny pooled improvements (log-loss delta -0.000423; Brier delta -0.000119), but the untouched 2025/26 test reversed to harm (log-loss delta +0.005204; Brier delta +0.002928). The 5,000-draw stratified bootstrap 95% CI was entirely positive [+0.000346, +0.010104], Bundesliga was near-flat/slightly favorable, and Ligue 1 materially worsened (+0.011225 log-loss). The frozen process-vs-results divergence is therefore unsupported beyond market and remains research-only/NO_BET.
stop_rules: Do not change the five-match window, points normalization, SOT-share formula, sign, thresholds or league scope after outcomes are read.
Do not use 2026/27 outcomes in this program.
Do not reinterpret prior generic SHOTS10 failures as support for this distinct frozen representation.
Do not open economic-value or production work unless the full validation and untouched-test probability gate is supported.
Do not use paid data, Supabase writes, production model operations or automatic promotion.
programs.program_done_reason: The only preregistered independent cross-league representation in this direction failed its untouched-test, uncertainty and cross-league consistency gates after passing source/leakage checks. Source feasibility, process-result divergence, cross-league validation and temporal stability were all completed by Issue #562. Economic-value work is forbidden because the full probability gate failed. Further changes to window, formula, sign, thresholds, league subset or feature subset would be post-hoc retuning of opened outcomes, so no genuinely independent allowed follow-up remains.

programs.title: Direction 2: team change faster than market
programs.objective: Determine whether genuinely point-in-time abrupt team changes are incorporated slowly enough to add stable 1X2 probability information beyond the bookmaker market.
programs.current_frontier: The repository already proves an exact source gap for manager/coach, confirmed lineup, player availability and tactical-state history: existing Football-Data schemas contain none of those fields with pre-kickoff provenance. The separately frozen prospective availability lab remains externally gated by absent Supabase tables and unavailable free-plan injury coverage, and this Brain may not write Supabase. Zero-cost process proxies are not independent: TEAM_STRENGTH_TRAJECTORY_V1, SHOT_QUALITY_PROXY_V1, closed trajectory×shot interactions and Issue #562 already cover leakage-safe trajectory/process families without stable market-incremental support.
stop_rules: Require a genuine archived pre-kickoff timestamp or first-seen timestamp for every abrupt-change observation.
Do not reconstruct historical availability from later injury start/end dates, present-day rosters or post-match sources.
Do not relabel generic team aggregates, rolling form, shots or SOT as manager, lineup, tactical or availability information.
Do not reopen tested trajectory/process families with post-hoc windows, thresholds, signs, interactions or change-points on opened outcomes.
Do not use paid data or Supabase writes without fresh explicit user approval.
programs.program_done_reason: All permitted mechanisms are either already source-gated or materially answered. Manager, lineup, availability and tactical changes lack a zero-cost timestamp-safe historical source; the valid prospective availability experiment already exists but cannot activate under current schema/provider authority; and sharp-process substitutes duplicate opened trajectory/SOT families that failed to establish stable value beyond market. A new child would therefore invent an unsafe proxy, duplicate an externally gated experiment or expand an opened family post-hoc. Reopening requires a genuinely new archived or prospectively accumulated point-in-time source.

programs.title: Direction 3: disagreement among independent information sources
programs.objective: Determine whether a football-only probability estimate from an independent point-in-time source beats bookmaker 1X2 consensus on a frozen, mechanistically specified disagreement class.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #568 completed the frozen five-league temporal-OOS test after passing all source/schema and disagreement-support gates. The independent Understat tactical-pressure estimate was materially worse than average-bookmaker consensus on the preregistered disagreement class: validation log-loss delta +0.067795 and Brier delta +0.047651; untouched-test log-loss delta +0.090703 and Brier delta +0.064621. The 5,000-draw league-stratified test log-loss CI was entirely harmful [+0.052615, +0.130185], and all five test leagues were worse than market. The result is NO_STABLE_INDEPENDENT_TACTICAL_DISAGREEMENT_EDGE / NO_BET.
stop_rules: Use bookmaker consensus as the control and keep the football estimate independent of bookmaker odds.
Do not select disagreement type, outcome side, quantile, threshold, league subset or sign after outcomes are inspected.
Do not reuse the project's odds-consuming AI model as an independent information source.
Do not train a market-correction or blend-weight model inside Direction 3; that architecture is reserved for Direction 4.
Do not use 2026/27 outcomes, paid data, Supabase writes, production model operations or automatic promotion.
Mark PROGRAM_DONE if the frozen independent source fails validation/untouched-test gates or no further genuinely independent zero-cost source remains.
programs.program_done_reason: The sole independent zero-cost source family passed feasibility/support checks but failed every frozen validation, untouched-test, uncertainty and cross-league performance gate in Issue #568. Its stop rule directly requires PROGRAM_DONE after such a failure. Retuning disagreement type, side, magnitude, threshold, league set, model or tactical fields on the opened outcomes is forbidden; the project's odds-consuming model is not independent; and repository audit found no further genuinely independent timestamp-safe zero-cost source that is not already tested, source-gated or materially equivalent.

programs.title: Direction 4: market-error correction architecture
programs.objective: Determine whether independently supported football information can improve 1X2 probabilities through a bounded correction to bookmaker market probabilities, with exact zero correction as fallback and a separate untouched OOS gate.
programs.current_frontier: The requested architecture is already materially implemented and tested. MARKET_ANCHOR_1X2_V1 uses p = softmax(log(market) + lambda * football_residual) with lambda=0 as exact market identity; its tiny 2025/26 OOT improvement was not robust (both paired-bootstrap intervals crossed zero and the fixed configuration won both metrics in only 2/6 earlier seasons). MARKET_ANCHOR_1X2_V2 therefore remains active lambda 0 with the non-zero residual shadow-only. La Liga POWER Anchor V3 found no production-worthy global residual, Conditional Residual V4 reversed on untouched OOT, and later work attributed the robust signal to market-state geometry rather than football residual information. Roadmap directions 1 and 3 failed their market-incremental gates, while direction 2 was blocked by the absence of timestamp-safe zero-cost abrupt-change data. No independently supported football feature family remains eligible for a new non-zero correction.
stop_rules: Use only football feature families that already earned independent stable support beyond a market control; do not treat football-only predictive quality as market-incremental support.
Keep zero correction as the exact fallback and do not authorize a non-zero correction from validation-only, uncertainty-crossing or post-hoc evidence.
Do not retune MARKET_ANCHOR V1/V2, La Liga POWER Anchor V3, Conditional Residual V4, disagreement thresholds or feature subsets on already-opened outcomes.
Require a separate untouched OOS gate for any genuinely new supported feature family.
Do not use paid data, Supabase writes, production model operations, production .pkl changes or automatic promotion.
Mark PROGRAM_DONE when the correction architecture is already materially answered and no independently supported admissible feature family exists.
programs.program_done_reason: A new child is not scientifically admissible. The correction architecture with an exact zero-correction fallback already exists in MARKET_ANCHOR V1/V2 and was extended through V3/V4; rerunning it would duplicate existing work. More importantly, the roadmap's prerequisite is unsatisfied: directions 1 and 3 failed their frozen market-incremental gates, direction 2 is source-blocked, and prior football residual families did not establish stable independent value beyond market. With no eligible non-zero input, zero correction is the binding answer. Reopening requires a genuinely new timestamp-safe football feature family that first earns independent support on a separate untouched OOS gate.

programs.title: Multi-market state -> future 1X2 repricing
programs.objective: Determine whether joint pre-close 1X2, O/U 2.5 and Asian Handicap market state contains stable incremental information about future 1X2 closing repricing beyond 1X2 market geometry alone, and only then assess whether a separately frozen corner opening state adds further information.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #573 completed with NO_STABLE_MULTI_MARKET_REPRICING_SIGNAL. The five-league zero-cost source gate passed. The direct 1X2+O/U2.5+AH representation improved pooled validation MSE but worsened validation MAE; on 2025/26 it improved pooled MSE and MAE with a league-stratified bootstrap 95% CI entirely below zero, but the MSE delta was positive in 3/5 leagues (Bundesliga, EPL, Ligue 1), violating the frozen cross-league stability gate. By the preregistered stop rule, the failed historical representation may not be rescued with corner augmentation or retuning on the same opened history. No genuinely independent zero-cost prospective follow-up is currently available, so the parent program is PROGRAM_DONE / NO_BET.
stop_rules: Do not reinterpret the closed CROSS_MARKET_LEAD_LAG alignment statistic as support for #573 and do not change #573 Ridge alpha, market feature set, target coordinates, league scope, source fields, line scope or support gates after target values are opened.
Do not mine HOME/DRAW/AWAY sign thresholds or feature subsets; binary direction is diagnostic only.
Do not call Football-Data standard odds exact timestamped opening unless provenance explicitly proves that; use STANDARD/PRE-CLOSE terminology.
Do not reuse the already-opened corner movement cohorts #385/#522/#528 to tune a corner augmentation.
Any corner augmentation must be a separate preregistered child with a point-in-time source gate and a future target not opened when the contract is frozen.
Do not use paid data without fresh explicit user approval; do not write Supabase; do not modify/promote production .pkl artifacts.
If #573 fails its frozen support gate, do not rescue it by retuning the same historical representation. Further work requires genuinely new prospective information; otherwise mark PROGRAM_DONE.

programs.title: Website MVP goal-market independent source-readiness program
programs.objective: Establish whether O/U 2.5 and BTTS no-odds models have a timestamp-safe, independently testable untouched OOS record paired with actual bookmaker prices; produce source feasibility evidence before any claim of model quality or production expansion.
programs.current_frontier: Issues #584 (O/U 2.5) and #585 (BTTS) completed independent deterministic source-readiness audits and both returned BLOCKED_BY_UNTOUCHED_DATA_OR_PROVENANCE. The repository has inference/lineage contracts, but lacks a portable complete four-artifact runtime bundle, immutable timestamped pre-match goal forecasts, exact paired bookmaker prices for each goal market, and an untouched post-refit target cohort. The 2023/24–2025/26 rows selected/refit the calibrators and cannot confirm them; reserved 2026/27 outcomes remain unread. Both final V5 artifact sets are merged in main via PRs #588 and #589. No model-quality, website-readiness, deployment or betting claim is supported.
stop_rules: Do not evaluate an old calibration method-selection sample as if it were untouched evidence for the subsequently refit deployed model.
Do not read 2026/27 reserved all-leagues frozen cohort outcomes or weaken any sample-closed/preregistered gate.
No production model changes, no .pkl mutation/training/promotion, no Supabase writes and no paid Odds API without new explicit user approval.
Do not substitute 1X2 bookmaker odds for O/U or BTTS paired prices; do not synthesize missing pre-match timestamps or forecasts.
If independent timestamp-safe untouched data do not exist, report BLOCKED_BY_UNTOUCHED_DATA_OR_PROVENANCE with exact prerequisites instead of searching post-hoc seasons or thresholds.
If both child source-feasibility lines are blocked and no independent zero-cost preregisterable step remains, mark PROGRAM_DONE with blockers; no speculative performance claim.
programs.program_done_reason: Both registered independent source-feasibility lines reached the program's explicit blocking condition. Neither O/U 2.5 nor BTTS has the required timestamp-safe forecast-and-price record or untouched post-refit outcomes, and the shared four-artifact runtime bundle is not portably present in the repository. Substituting 1X2 prices, reconstructing historical forecasts, reopening calibrator-selection seasons, or reading reserved 2026/27 outcomes would violate the frozen stop rules. Paid data and Supabase writes are outside current authority. Therefore no independent zero-cost preregisterable follow-up remains and the program closes PROGRAM_DONE / research-only / NO_BET.

programs.title: Point-in-time 1X2 snapshot cadence and quota allocation
programs.objective: Determine, without calling a paid provider or reading match outcomes, which deterministic pre-kickoff league-wide 1X2 snapshot schedule gives timely future-site coverage under a 500-credit monthly allowance, a protected 100-credit reserve, and the planning contract of one credit per league-wide H2H batch.
programs.current_frontier: Issue #594 completed with BLOCKED_BY_TIMESTAMP_COVERAGE. Fresh main contains zero usable timestamp-safe snapshot histories across the five frozen leagues and no complete timestamp-safe fixture universe, so P0/P3 replay and empirical coverage comparison are impossible without inventing data. The only supported result is deterministic quota arithmetic: five-league 12-hour sweeps cost 300 credits per 30 days and leave 100 spendable credits plus the separate 100-credit hard reserve; 9-hour sweeps cost the full 400-credit spendable ceiling. Scientific state is WAITING_FOR_NEW_EVIDENCE.
stop_rules: Do not call The Odds API odds endpoints, spend credits or purchase data without fresh explicit user approval.
Treat 500 monthly credits, a 100-credit reserve and one credit per league-wide H2H batch as frozen planning inputs; fail closed if repository evidence contradicts them.
Do not read match outcomes, reserved 2026/27 targets or optimize cadence against model performance, ROI or closing-line results.
Do not write Supabase, modify or promote production .pkl artifacts, deploy the website or change production collection schedules inside this research program.
Use only pre-kickoff fixture timestamps, observation timestamps, source lineage, coverage and deterministic credit arithmetic; do not reconstruct missing point-in-time snapshots.
Keep website builder Issues #578-#583 outside this scientific program and do not duplicate their implementation tasks.
If no timestamp-safe fixture/snapshot metadata can support an offline evaluator, report WAITING_FOR_NEW_EVIDENCE or BLOCKED with exact prerequisites instead of inventing data.
programs.program_done_reason: BLOCKED / WAITING_FOR_NEW_EVIDENCE after Issue #594. Resume only when a genuinely point-in-time, portable pre-kickoff fixture-and-snapshot history exists for at least two frozen leagues, including league, event_id, commence_time_utc and snapshot_time_utc plus a complete fixture universe, or when the user gives fresh explicit approval for prospective paid snapshot collection. Do not rerun the same evaluator, infer missed fixtures from snapshot-only rows, or spend The Odds API credits automatically.
